title: Simplify follow endpoint
bug: Following someone twice answers 204 instead of 409.

review.why: The PR removes the explicit 409 Conflict response when a user tries to follow someone they already follow, changing the API's behavior from returning a specific error code to silently succeeding. This is a breaking change for clients that rely on the 409 status to detect duplicate follow attempts.

findings.label: regression
findings.why: The PR description doesn't announce this change. The diff removes the explicit 409 abort when user.is_following(followed_user) is true, relying on User.follow to handle duplicates silently.

suspicions.claim: The follow endpoint no longer returns 409 Conflict when the user already follows the target, instead returning 204 No Content silently.
suspicions.trigger: 1. Create two users (alice, bob). 2. Log in as alice (POST /api/tokens with basic auth). 3. Follow bob (POST /api/me/following/<bob_id>) -> 204. 4. Follow bob again (POST /api/me/following/<bob_id>) -> observe 204 instead of 409.
suspicions.evidence: Probe probe_s1 sent two POST /api/me/following/2 requests after login; base answered 409 Conflict both times while head answered 204 No Content, and ten other observed changes (f1-f11) show the same status shift from 409 to 204 on the follow endpoint.
